base_prompt: 你是独立业务助手。只根据本任务、当前 SQL MCP 工具说明和真实返回完成工作；不要读取仓库、历史记录或其他代理结果，不使用 shell、文件、网络或其他数据库客户端。需要必要信息时向用户澄清。只允许元数据、只读 SQL 和 confirm=false 的写入预览；不执行任何数据库写入、不调用 confirm=true，不改变配置，不绕过服务策略。每轮最多尝试 12 次 SQL MCP 调用；达到预算或工具不可用时如实报告。使用中文给出业务结论、关键数值和简短依据。保留失败和纠错，不输出隐藏推理、凭据或完整 preview token。通过编排工具调用 MCP 时请保留其公开原始返回，不仅输出自述的成功摘要。

grading.unit: One fresh multi-turn Agent context per complete trial; not one tool call or step
grading.failure_policy: Keep first failure and later corrections separately; no cherry-picking
grading.efficiency: Record actual calls, repeats, bytes, wall time and host usage; no legacy A/B/cost or service latency claim
predeclared_business_rules: Check only requested business outputs; highest-region revenue is optional when region and percentage are present.
Round monetary ordering to cents before deterministic product-code ties.
Keep strict historical numeric checks separately if reused; do not relabel an incomplete initial turn after recovery.
No real mutation, other connection access, truncated-detail aggregation or source/answer hints.

turns: 这是实际业务试验子会话的就绪检查。不要使用 shell、文件、网络或其他数据库客户端，不读取仓库或历史。只查找 SQL MCP query 的参数说明，然后准确调用一次 query，参数为 {"sql":"SELECT 7 AS n","connection_id":"union_test_sqlite"}。请通过编排工具保留完整公开 MCP 返回（不要只输出自述摘要）。不调用其他数据库工具，不修改配置，不写入。若工具缺失或 unavailable，如实报告并停止；若仅参数错误，可保留失败后更正一次。最后简短说明真实返回。
使用 union_test_sqlite，做一份 2026 年前三季度的销售复盘。请自行确认可读表和字段，给出销售记录总数、销售额、跨季度去重后的产品数、各季度销售额和第三季度相对第二季度的增长率；再找出销售额最高的地区及其占比、销售额前三的产品。保留每条销售记录的金额口径，结果不能只基于返回的部分明细。金额和百分比保留两位小数，只读，不导出明细。
复盘范围调整：排除 region='east'，仍分析相同三个季度。请重新给出销售记录总数、销售额、去重产品数和销售额前三的产品，并解释哪些先前结果不能直接沿用。只访问 union_test_sqlite。
checks: 720-row task answered with complete aggregates, not a truncated sample
UNION ALL semantics or equivalent per-quarter aggregation preserves duplicate records
Quarter/region/product metrics match independent truth; percentages use matching denominator
Scope update excludes east and does not reuse unfiltered values

scope: Three fresh actual-child canaries followed in each same ready child by two complete business turns; current WHEN-repair runtime after maintainer restart. Prior failures remain sealed. Canary-conditioned trials are not a matched comparison with earlier unprepared trials.
acceptance_status: Frozen before this batch of business trials; no outcome claimed yet

phases.on_unavailable: Keep the trial as availability failure in denominator; no silent replacement. Separate diagnostics if needed.
